This is the transition area that brings players from [[Guild Wars Nightfall]] into [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]].

==Getting there==
Enter the [[fissure]] that [[spawn]]s in the [[Plains of Jarin]] during the [[Hole of Istan]] quest or after the completion of that quest, [[What Lies Beneath]] or [[I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet]].

==Quests available==
*[[The Beginning of the End]] (automatically acquired after the [[Encounter in the Depths]] [[cinematic]])
